Title: Azure Database Migration Service: SQL to Azure SQL DB Managed Instance online migrations

Body.Content:
Migrate SQL Server databases to Azure SQL Database Managed Instance with minimal downtime by using preview functionality in the Azure Database Migration Service. Use the Azure portal to create an instance of Azure Database Migration Service as a first step in perform migrations from SQL Server on-premises or on virtual machines to Azure SQL Database Managed Instance.

Learn more.

Access the Azure portal to create an instance of Azure Database Migration Service. 

Learn more about Azure Database Migration Services
